\section*{Multiple Choice (4 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item Which of the following is not a characteristic of \duallayerbox{totalitarian}{democratic} societies?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item indoctrination and propaganda
    \item freedom of movement for citizens
    \item one-party rule
    \item a centrally planned economy
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following best describes the practice of placing the blame for the problems of a society on \duallayerbox{one particular group}{another culture}?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Ethnocentrism
    \item Stereotyping
    \item Scapegoating
    \item Institutionalization
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (36 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False and justify briefly.}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Scott (1991)}{Mills (1956)} introduced the term 'power elite' to describe:' is 'a \duallayerbox{capitalist class}{political leaders} dependent on property ownership and advantaged life chances'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Stone's research}{Smith's analysis} suggests that prior to industrialization, the \duallayerbox{nuclear family}{extended family}:' is 'had begun to disappear, as extended networks of kin became more important'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Dahrendorf, Rex, and Habermas}{Weber and Durkheim} focused their attention on:' is '\duallayerbox{social solidarity and cohesion}{class conflict and power}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Marxist feminists}{Functionalists} explain patriarchy in terms of:' is '\duallayerbox{women's domestic labour}{gender roles} being exploited by the capitalist economy'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Butler \textbackslash{}\& Stokes (1969)}{Jones \& Smith (1970)} suggested that working class support for the Labour Party arose from:' is '\duallayerbox{false consciousness}{economic interests} and the acceptance of hegemonic values'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Mulholland (1998)}{Johnson (2000)} argued that privatization changed the relationship between companies and managers in that:' is '\duallayerbox{employment depended on performance}{trust was the key factor} rather than trust and commitment'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Sociology can be considered}{Psychology is often seen} a social science because:' is '\duallayerbox{all of the above}{it uses qualitative methods}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{White-collar crime}{Cybercrime} is low in visibility because:' is 'it goes undetected in the context of \duallayerbox{everyday business transactions}{public scrutiny}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Sullivan's (2000)}{Johnson's (2001)} study suggested that the proportion of housework men did was greatest when:' is 'they were unemployed or both partners worked full time'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'According to \duallayerbox{Scott (1990)}{Jones (1991)}, a document is 'authentic' if it:' is 'is a 'sound' original, or reliable copy, of known authorship'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'The human relations approach emphasized the importance of:' is 'teamwork, communication and employee satisfaction'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Technological forms of surveillance have made it easier to:' is 'reduce prison overcrowding by the use of electronic tagging'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the following is not a regular national survey carried out by the British government?' is 'Fashion Sensibility Survey'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'The 'new man' of the 1980s was alleged to be:' is 'sensitive, caring, and emotional'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'One of the ethical problems with covert participant observation is:' is 'deceiving the respondents as to the reason for your presence'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'The middle classes that developed over the nineteenth century were:' is 'all of the above'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'When sociologists study the structure of layers in society and people's movement between them, they call this:' is 'social solidarity'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Murray thought that the 'underclass' consisted of people who:' is 'all of the above'.
\end{enumerate}
